Game Overview

In Bouncing Bug, the core idea is straightforward: help a quirky bug navigate its way through a bouncy box filled with lurking monsters. Skillfully change its direction to dodge threats while snatching shiny treasures and tasty treats to survive. Test your reflexes in this dynamic, gravity-defying adventure and unlock a variety of bug companions.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Bouncing Bug is easy to pick up. Help a quirky bug navigate its way through a bouncy box filled with lurking monsters.
